High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:174444
Court No. - 66

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 40657 of 2024
Applicant :- Suraj Kumar Tripathi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Amarnath Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Amarnath Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Shatrughan Yadav,
learned Aga, for the State.

2.  The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.117 of 2024, under Sections 498A and 304B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Charwa, District Kaushambi during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his parents and according to the FIR marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the daughter of the informant about four years before and after two years of marriage applicant and his parents made a demand of motorcycle and when informant fulfilled the same then they started making demand of Rs. Three Lacs and due to demand of Rs.Three Lacs they started torturing his daughter and on 12.5.2024 informant received an information that his daughter has died.

Suraj Kumar Tripathi vs State Of U.P. on 7 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44918393/

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is husband of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture he has been made accused in the present matter along with his parents.
5. He further submits that actually accidentally by falling deceased sustained one head injury and died.
6. He further submits that even the post mortem report of the deceased suggests that she sustained one head injury and died due to head injury.
7.

He further submits that immediately after the incident applicant informed the informant and after receiving information informant arrived at spot and in his presence inquest was conducted and he was one of the inquest witness but at that time he did not raise any objection and after six days after due consultation on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, FIR of the present case was lodged.
He next submits that the inquest report has been annexed at page 37 of the paper book.
8. He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 21.5.2024, i.e., for the last more than five months 9.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that applicant is the husband of the deceased and his wife died within four years of her marriage due to head injury, therefore, her death is abnormal death and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but he could not dispute the fact that from the inquest report it reflects that on the information given by applicant informant arrived at spot and in his presence inquest was conducted and informant was one of the inquest witness but in spite of that FIR of the present case was lodged after six days.
10.
Learned AGA further could not dispute the fact that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that deceased sustained one injury on her head and it appears that she died due to head injury.
11. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. However, applicant is the husband of the deceased and his wife died within four years of her marriage due to head injury and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but from the perusal of the inquest report it reflects that information of the alleged incident was immediately given by applicant to the informant and thereafter informant arrived at spot and in his presence inquest was conducted and he was also one of the inquest witness but at that time he did not raise any objection and after about six days he lodged FIR of the present case
, therefore, argument advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant that FIR was lodged after consultation on false facts, cannot be completely brushed aside at this stage.

13. Further, as per the applicant accidentally by falling deceased sustained one head injury and unfortunately died and considering the post mortem report of the deceased which suggests that Suraj Kumar Tripathi vs State Of U.P. on 7 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44918393/
2 deceased sustained one head injury, the argument advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant cannot be ruled out at this stage.

sentences.text: 14. Further, applicant is not having any previous criminal history and he is in jail the present matter since May, 2024, i.e., for the last more than five months.

15. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
16. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

17. Let the applicant-Suraj Kumar Tripathi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
18.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

19. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
